title: Near x = ψ(v₀), the set N ∩ W coincides with the chart image of any open ball around v₀ contained in V (parent step 3)
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ, N, W, W₀ ⊆ ℝ^P, V ⊆ ℝ^m, ψ : ℝ^m → ℝ^P, v₀ ∈ V and ρ > 0. Assume W and W₀ are open, ψ is continuous on V and injective on V, ψ(V) = W₀ ∩ N, V ∩ ψ^{-1}(K) is compact for every compact K ⊆ W₀, ψ(v₀) ∈ W, and the open ball B_ρ(v₀) is contained in V. Then there is δ > 0 with (N ∩ W) ∩ B_δ(ψ(v₀)) = ψ(B_ρ(v₀)) ∩ B_δ(ψ(v₀)).
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (N W W₀ : Set (Euclid P)) (V : Set (Euclid m)) (ψ : Euclid m → Euclid P) (v₀ : Euclid m) (ρ : ℝ), IsOpen W → IsOpen W₀ → ContinuousOn ψ V → InjOn ψ V → ψ '' V = W₀ ∩ N → (∀ K ⊆ W₀, IsCompact K → IsCompact (V ∩ ψ ⁻¹' K)) → v₀ ∈ V → ψ v₀ ∈ W → 0 < ρ → ball v₀ ρ ⊆ V → ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ N ∩ W ∩ ball (ψ v₀) δ = ψ '' ball v₀ ρ ∩ ball (ψ v₀) δ
